run_cartpole_gui: run the cartpole GUI demo using the mujoco_mpc agent_lib Agent with a Cartpole task model
load_cartpole_model: load a cartpole MuJoCo model from an XML task file using mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path
create_agent_context: create an agent_lib.Agent context manager with server binary path, task_id, and MuJoCo model
build_cartpole_demo: build a cartpole GUI demo script that loads a model and runs the mjpc ui_agent_server
test_agent_gui: test the cartpole GUI demo by running the agent context manager in a loop
